§ 1648. Administration of the Nurse Licensure Compact

definition_quote.value: Registered nursing means the practice of nursing, which includes: Assessing the health status of individuals and groups; Establishing a nursing diagnosis; Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs; Planning a strategy of medical or health care; Prescribing nursing interventions to implement the strategy of care; Implementing the strategy of care; Delegating nursing interventions that may be performed by others; Maintaining safe and effective nursing care rendered directly or indirectly; Evaluating responses to interventions; Teaching the theory and practice of nursing; Managing and supervising the practice of nursing; Collaborating with other health professionals in the management of health care; Addressing patient pain; and Performance of such additional acts requiring education and training recognized jointly by the medical and nursing professions.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing" means the practice of nursing, which includes: (A) Assessing the health status of individuals and groups. (B) Establishing a nursing diagnosis.
